nodes.name: colors.xml
nodes.summary: Android color resource file defining the default Material palette (purple, teal, black, white) generated for the floppy Android app.
nodes.languageNotes: Standard Android res/values color resources using ARGB hex literals.

nodes.name: ic_launcher_background.xml
nodes.summary: Defines the white background color used by the adaptive launcher icon for the floppy Android app.

nodes.name: strings.xml
nodes.summary: Android string resources providing the app name and main activity title ('floppy') for the Android build.

nodes.name: themes.xml
nodes.summary: Defines the Theme.floppy Material DayNight base theme configuring edge-to-edge display with transparent system bars, light bar icons, and display-cutout drawing so the webview shell renders correctly from the first frame.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Theme.MaterialComponents.DayNight.NoActionBar with edge-to-edge attributes (transparent status/navigation bars, disabled contrast enforcement, shortEdges cutout mode) set in XML so they apply before the Kotlin activity or webview initializes.
